newsitem.title: CANADA: Nortel in deal with ATT Wireless.
newsitem.headline: Nortel in deal with ATT Wireless.

text.p: Northern Telecom Ltd said on Tuesday its Companion Microcellular system will be offered for use in AT&T Wireless Services digital PCS wireless service.
The combination will allow companies complete access all over their operations from the manufacturing floor to the office or on the road anywhere in the North American cellular network.

Nortel said the marriage of the two systems would allow the personal communications services (PCS) handset to be used as a full-feature office telephone within an enterprise and to use AT&T's digital PCS abilities when outside.
